settings.title: What is this for?
settings.content:
These applicator probes are used for non-invasive facial toning and lifting treatments. They help:

  • Tone and firm facial muscles

  • Reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles

  • Improve skin texture and elasticity

Ideal for professional estheticians and at-home users who want effective, device-assisted facial rejuvenation.

settings.title: What is included?
settings.content: One pair of double-tipped applicator probes (compatible with MyoLift™ Mini, 600, and Triwave devices)

settings.title: How To Use
settings.content:
Preparation

  • Cleanse your face and pat it dry.
  • Apply a water-based conductive gel or serum to the treatment area.

Device Setup

  • Connect the applicator probes to your MyoLift™ device.
  • Select the desired mode (Educate, Erase, or Rejuv).

Application

  • Use the "pinch-and-hold" technique to grasp the targeted facial muscle.
  • Glide the probes along facial contours as instructed for the selected mode.

Post-Treatment

  • Remove any leftover gel.
  • Clean the probes with a disinfectant wipe and store them properly.

Treatments are typically recommended 2–3 times per week for best results.
